subject: Port OSv modifications to OpenZFS
description:
Phase 3 of ZFS update: Adapt OSv-specific modifications to OpenZFS codebase using the platform abstraction.

**NEW STRATEGY**: OpenZFS 2.3.6 has platform-split architecture (module/os/<platform>/). Create clean module/os/osv/ directory instead of patching common code.

Tasks:
1. Create module/os/osv/ directory structure in external/openzfs:
   - module/os/osv/zfs/ (12 OS-specific implementations)
   - module/os/osv/spl/ (Solaris Porting Layer for OSv)
   
2. Implement OSv-specific files (reference from task #1 patches + FreeBSD/Linux versions):
   - vdev_disk_osv.c - Complete rewrite for OSv bio layer + ABD integration
   - arc_os.c - ARC memory management with OSv shrinker callbacks
   - zfs_ioctl_os.c - OSv-specific ioctl handlers
   - zfs_vfsops_os.c - VFS integration with constructor pattern
   - zfs_vnops_os.c - Vnode operations
   - zvol_os.c - Block volume support
   - zfs_ctldir_os.c - Control directory (.zfs/)
   - zio_crypt_os.c - Encryption hooks
   - Plus ~4 more OS-specific files
   
3. Adapt to ABD (Abstract Buffer Data) API:
   - vdev_disk_osv.c must use abd_* functions instead of raw pointers
   - Update bio integration to map ABD scatter/gather to bio buffers
   
4. Preserve OSv integration patterns from task #1:
   - Constructor-based initialization (fs/zfs/zfs_initialize.c)
   - Four callback registrations (ioctl, ARC shrinker, pagecache, VFS ops)
   - Memory locking annotation
   
5. Update fs/zfs/zfs_initialize.c to work with OpenZFS 2.3.6 APIs

6. Configure OpenZFS build system to recognize 'osv' platform

Prerequisites:
- Tasks 1 and 2 complete ✓

Critical references:
- module/os/linux/ - Reference implementation
- module/os/freebsd/ - Alternative reference
- bsd/sys/cddl/osv-patches/ - OSv modification documentation from task #1

Timeline: 4-6 weeks (this is the most complex phase)
activeForm: Porting OSv modifications to OpenZFS platform layer
